purpose: Baseline predictions and guard-validation evidence join one sample at a time. This file is the single field contract for both branches; do not rename fields without bumping schema_version and updating both sides.

knowledge_id.note: The published JSON has 187 rows but only 107 distinct CVE ids; 34 CVE groups contain multiple records, so CVE alone is not a unique knowledge id. Array index is the 0-based position in the fixed file. Updating the knowledge file creates a new file version; old indexes must not be reused.

pair_id.note: PrimeVul/RAG4SVD pairs use the upstream bucket and record id. Local dev fixtures use the local-dev prefix and must be registered separately; they are not part of the evaluation set.

variant.ineffective-01: derived guard that still violates (boundary condition weakened, e.g. >= changed to >)
variant.equivalent-01: derived guard that rewrites the same check equivalently
variant.caller-01: derived guard moved to the caller side
variant.developer_fix: local-fixture role name for the real upstream fix; register parent pair_id
variant.original: local-fixture role name for the vulnerable version; register parent pair_id

label.1: vulnerable (ground truth, kept in the evaluation manifest; never injected into the model prompt)

prediction.-1: unresolved / early exit / unparsed; must not be counted as safe

evidence_status.triggered: violation observed on this version under the recorded inputs
evidence_status.not_triggered: recorded inputs did not trigger; not equivalent to a general safety claim
evidence_status.inconclusive: ran but observations are insufficient to judge

prediction_record.produced_by: baseline-primevul side; the only side that calls the detection model

fields.cve_id: CVE identifier associated with the pair
fields.cwe: CWE identifier associated with the pair
fields.label: ground-truth label, see enums.label
fields.evaluated_knowledge_cves: CVE ids of the knowledge candidates actually evaluated by the model; may be shorter than the full retrieval list when early return fired
fields.code_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact code bytes fed to the model; if the model input is only the target function while the harness hash covers the whole stub, store a separate model-code hash and do not reuse the harness hash

evidence_record.produced_by: guard-validation side; no model/API calls on this side

fields.run: joins the baseline repetition number; empty for standalone local-dev evidence
fields.validation_method: what was actually checked, e.g. logical-capacity sentinel; not ASan and not full kernel execution
fields.source_commit: upstream revision the fixture was derived from
fields.exit_code: process exit code or null on timeout
fields.observations: per-input observations; keep the full grid, do not collapse to a single boolean

rules: Predictions and evidence are matched on the join keys above.
Missing counterpart, differing code_sha256, or duplicated prediction/evidence rows must be reported explicitly; never silently drop or overwrite them.
One sample may have several evidence_id rows; do not compress them into one boolean.
not_triggered only means the recorded inputs did not trigger; it is not a general safety conclusion.
The guard side submits new samples or methods as a request list; the baseline side schedules the model calls so the same sample is not run twice.
run_id / run binds an immutable configuration: method, model, prompt, retrieval parameters, or data changes require a new run.
Dedup key at least: run, sample_id, code_sha256, method, model, prompt_sha256, config_sha256; multi-stage RAG also records stage, knowledge_id, and request-body hash.
Keys stay in environment variables or local hidden input; never commit them.
